item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I am William. I work on strategy and skill learning for multi-robot systems.

A single robot can be trained to do a hard thing. A team has to solve a harder problem: decide who does what, act on what the others are likely to do, and keep improving while the others are also improving. It also has to detect what another agent intends and react to it, whether that agent is a dynamic obstacle or actively adversarial. I approach these problems through reinforcement learning and game theory.
